name: GoldHash
description: GoldHash is a next-generation mining token built on the TON blockchain, combining the power of blockchain technology with community-driven reward systems. The name GoldHash reflects two core elements of our vision: Gold — Symbolizing value, scarcity, and trust. Like gold in the physical world, GoldHash is designed to be a valuable digital asset with a sustainable ecosystem. Hash — Honoring the Proof-of-Work principles that form the foundation of the crypto industry. Hash is the core of mining, and GoldHash delivers an innovative and transparent mining experience.
